## 主张 Claim

沿固定关系规律中的实际有限历史，全部存在性端点可能保留当且仅当存在返回路径。无法返回具有构造性的丧失端点见证；不完整问题集合可以遮蔽此损失。 / Along an actual finite trace under a fixed relational law, all existential endpoint possibilities are preserved exactly when a return path exists. Failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint witness; incomplete questions can hide this loss.
